nodes.text: It's okay. Sometimes bad things happen to good people.

nodes.text: We just have to learn to accept what we can't change and move on with our lives.

nodes.text: Unbelievable. After all this time, you don't understand me at all.

nodes.text: I'm upset because I let tragedy alter the course of my life, and now it's too late to change it.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I'll never know what my life would've been like if I'd stuck to this list.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I mean, the accident shaped you into the strong person you are today.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But seeing this list has to make you wonder what your life would've been like if you'd done things differently.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yeah, I know it's silly, but...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No, it isn't silly! You're about to make a big change. It's natural to look back at your life and take stock.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yeah, you're right.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Even so. It's not like I can do anything about it now.

nodes.text: Hey, you're off to a great start!

nodes.text: How would I know?! I'm the valedictorian. I've never gotten one.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Now leave me alone!

nodes.text: You see, I've always wanted to get perfect grades.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: This year I almost had it, but I'm getting a B in Biology.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: This afternoon, I'm taking my Biology final. If I get an A+, it will raise my average for the semester to a flat A.

nodes.text: I see. You want perfect grades, huh? Well, let me tell you, they don't come easy.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: It'll take blood and sweat and six other fluids... Only four of which can be synthesized in a chemistry lab.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Or instead, you could just study with me!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: After four long years of late nights, espresso shots, and itchy, bloodshot eyes, I've developed a foolproof system for test preparation.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: I call it the `C.R.A.M. Method.` The acronym stands for 'Cogitative Response for Academic Maximization'.

nodes.speaker: Dinah

nodes.text: 'These past four years have been full of varied accomplishments. For some the emphasis was on sports, for others academics or debate or shop class...'
